 Mr. Justice M.S.Raman
 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

Government Advocate appearing for the State-opposite parties states that against the award passed, the matter has already been referred to the Civil Court under Section 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In view of the above submission, it is open to the petitioner to pursue his remedy before the appropriate forum in accordance with law.

5. With the aforesaid liberty, the writ petition stands disposed of.
